recognize.text:
She is waiting in the doorway of the temple with her hands still.

"I have been singing the same line for **three days**. Ninshubur. And then you come in from the harbor with that face, and I stop being able to sing it." She does not step aside. "Tell me what you know, and tell me plainly. I have had enough of people being careful with me."

choices.text: It is a name from the east. A messenger's name.
choices.unavailableNote: You do not have the Akkadian to say it, and a guess would be worse.

choices.text: What do you want me to say?

east.text: "**A servant of the lady of the evening**. A messenger." She says it slowly, testing it. "That is what the trader said, and then he would not say more, and I have been singing it at strangers ever since." She looks at her hands. "My sister would have liked you. She liked people who answered."

never.text:
"No. But the hymn knows you, and I would like to know how."

She does not say it as an accusation. That is somehow worse. "You are not the first stranger I have sung it at. You are the first who did not ask me to sing it again."

want.text: "I want to know whether the name is older than the man wearing it. If it is, it is a hymn. If it is not, it is a joke, and I have been made part of it." She folds her arms. "My sister is dead a year and I am still arguing with a word. You may think that is foolish. I do not."

choices.text: And if it is a joke? What will you do then?

joke.text: "Then I will sing something else, and the name will go back to being a name." She says it as if the decision were already made. "But not until I know which it is. I owe her that much, and she is not here to argue."

cannot.text: "Then we are both waiting." She goes back inside. The singing starts again, four lines, and stops in the same place.

sources: Ninshubur as a divine name in Sumerian and Akkadian sources, general
provenance.notes: The theonym is documented. The recognition scene is fiction: no line asserts an identity with the traveler or with any later figure.

scene.goal: Find out why the name follows her
scene.obstacle: She cannot prove what she suspects
scene.turn: She names the trader and the funeral
